findings.highlight: would have died from that rain of light
findings.evidenceJa: 光弾の雨を躱せずバラバラになっていただろう
findings.governingReading: would have failed to evade that rain of light and been torn to pieces
findings.explanation: The concrete bodily result of Archer’s second rescue becomes generic death.

findings.highlight: letting Caster go
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターを容認したこいつの言動
findings.governingReading: his words and conduct condoning Caster
findings.explanation: Shirou objects to Archer’s moral toleration of Caster, not merely the tactical release.

findings.highlight: Even if I did attack her
findings.evidenceJa: ここで斬り伏せたところで
findings.governingReading: Even if I cut her down here
findings.explanation: Archer’s claim that even defeating Caster’s present body would fail is weakened to merely attacking.

findings.highlight: she will eventually disappear if we defeat her Master
findings.evidenceJa: 依り代であるマスターが倒されれば、キャスターとて消えざるをえない
findings.governingReading: if the Master serving as her anchor is defeated, even Caster must disappear
findings.explanation: The Master’s anchoring function disappears and the English adds an unspecified delay.

findings.highlight: the correct and the safest approach
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯戦争における正攻法
findings.governingReading: the orthodox strategy in the Holy Grail War, and the least dangerous choice
findings.explanation: A conventional tactical method is promoted into the singular morally or objectively correct approach.

findings.highlight: sucking up magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: 人々から生気を吸い上げ
findings.governingReading: drain life force from people
findings.explanation: Caster’s resource extraction from civilians is changed from life force to magical energy.

findings.highlight: My head heats up.
findings.evidenceJa: カア、と顔が熱くなった
findings.governingReading: My face flushes hot.
findings.explanation: A visible flush of anger becomes an odd internal heating of the head.

findings.highlight: Caster’s too reserved
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターも手緩い
findings.governingReading: Caster is too lenient
findings.explanation: Archer’s criticism of Caster’s restraint in harming civilians becomes a personality description.

findings.highlight: if everybody in this town dies
findings.evidenceJa: 町中の人間が死に絶えれば
findings.governingReading: if the people throughout the town die out
findings.explanation: The image of the town being depopulated is flattened into a generic universal conditional.

findings.highlight: My Master’s too optimistic
findings.evidenceJa: 私のマスターも根は甘い
findings.governingReading: My Master is softhearted at her core
findings.explanation: Rin’s moral softness is changed into optimism.

findings.highlight: she’ll do anything to win
findings.evidenceJa: 形振りなどに構ってはいられまい
findings.governingReading: she will no longer be able to concern herself with appearances or methods
findings.explanation: Archer predicts Rin will abandon restraint under necessity; the English adds victory as her stated end.

findings.highlight: states with a smile
findings.evidenceJa: 乾いた笑みをうかべながら
findings.governingReading: speaks with a dry smile
findings.explanation: The dryness qualifying Archer’s apparently amused provocation disappears.

findings.highlight: Rin’s the type that is concerned with formality
findings.evidenceJa: 凛は形式に拘るタイプ
findings.governingReading: Rin is the type to insist on proper forms and conventions
findings.explanation: Archer’s criticism of Rin’s procedural scruples becomes generic social formality.

findings.highlight: sacrifice people around me to win
findings.evidenceJa: 勝つ為に[line3]結果の為に周りを犠牲にする
findings.governingReading: sacrifice those around me to win—for the sake of the result
findings.explanation: Shirou’s repeated opposition to consequentialist sacrifice loses its explicit “for the result” formulation.

findings.highlight: will not use the Holy Grail for your own good
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯を私利私欲で使わぬ
findings.governingReading: would not use the Holy Grail for selfish personal desires
findings.explanation: Using the Grail selfishly becomes using it for one’s own good, which can sound benign.

findings.highlight: unless we win the Holy Grail War
findings.evidenceJa: 私たちが勝利しなければ
findings.governingReading: unless we are victorious
findings.explanation: The English specifies winning the war, narrowing an argument whose immediate logic is control of the Grail and prevention of harm.

findings.highlight: we will sacrifice the people in this town for our benefit
findings.evidenceJa: 町の人間には犠牲になってもらい、私たちの役に立ってもらう
findings.governingReading: we must have the townspeople become sacrifices and serve our purpose
findings.explanation: The provocative benefactive phrasing is recast as a direct declaration that Archer’s group will perform the sacrifice.

findings.highlight: I shouldn’t feel anything
findings.evidenceJa: 何の衝撃も受けない筈
findings.governingReading: it should not shock me at all
findings.explanation: A specific lack of surprise or shock becomes emotional numbness in general.

findings.highlight: if you try to save everybody
findings.evidenceJa: 一人も殺さない、などという方法では
findings.governingReading: by a method that kills not a single person
findings.explanation: Archer’s attack on absolute non-killing is replaced with a different claim about trying to save everyone.

findings.highlight: like a friend
findings.evidenceJa: 死線を共にくぐり抜けた友人
findings.governingReading: as a friend who passed through the jaws of death beside you
findings.explanation: Archer’s mock-intimate basis for demanding gratitude is reduced to generic friendship.

findings.highlight: I won’t ask for your help even if you offer it to me
findings.evidenceJa: 頼まれたっておまえの手助けなんていらない
findings.governingReading: I would not want your help even if you begged me to take it
findings.explanation: Who makes the request is reversed, weakening Shirou’s emphatic rejection.

findings.highlight: Good thing you don’t like me.
findings.evidenceJa: 懐かれなくて何よりだ
findings.governingReading: All the better that you have not grown attached to me.
findings.explanation: Archer’s chilling rejection of attachment is reduced to simple dislike.

findings.highlight: I’m cut at my shoulder.
findings.evidenceJa: 肩口から袈裟に斬られた感触
findings.governingReading: the sensation of being cut diagonally down from the shoulder
findings.explanation: The direction and extent of Archer’s near-fatal slash disappear.

findings.highlight: it feels like my body is burning
findings.evidenceJa: 肌と肉が焼かれているかのよう
findings.governingReading: as though my skin and flesh are being burned
findings.explanation: Specific layers of the wound become the whole body.

findings.highlight: I slowly retreat
findings.evidenceJa: 後ろ歩きのまま、よろよろと後退
findings.governingReading: I stagger backward while still walking in reverse
findings.explanation: The precarious backward movement toward the gate is flattened.

findings.highlight: The plain swords
findings.evidenceJa: 飾り気のないソレ
findings.governingReading: that unadorned blade
findings.explanation: The singular white sword holding Shirou’s gaze becomes multiple swords.

findings.highlight: Since you do not have a reason to fight
findings.evidenceJa: 戦う意義のない衛宮士郎
findings.governingReading: Emiya Shirou, whose fighting has no meaning
findings.explanation: Archer denies the value of Shirou’s mode of fighting; the English instead says Shirou lacks a motive.

findings.highlight: He aims for the wound on my shoulder to cut my body for sure this time
findings.evidenceJa: もう一度袈裟に振り落とされた刀は、完全にこの体を断とうとする
findings.governingReading: The blade swings down diagonally once more, trying to sever my body completely
findings.explanation: The English invents deliberate targeting of the existing wound and loses the repeated stroke.

findings.highlight: A big impact.
findings.evidenceJa: ガン、という衝撃
findings.governingReading: an impact with a hard clang
findings.explanation: The hard, onomatopoeic quality of Shirou striking the steps disappears.

findings.highlight: I try to lift my body up
findings.evidenceJa: ぬるり、と血に濡れた体を起こそうとして
findings.governingReading: I try to raise my blood-soaked, slick body
findings.explanation: The tactile blood imagery is omitted from Shirou’s failed attempt to rise.

findings.highlight: You were pushed down the steps
findings.evidenceJa: なお階段から叩き落としたのか
findings.governingReading: and then still knocked him down the stairs
findings.explanation: Saber’s accusation of the attacker as the agent is made passive.

findings.highlight: there’s another Servant here
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーのすぐ近くにはもう一人
findings.governingReading: there is another Servant right beside Saber
findings.explanation: The proximity that makes Shirou fear an immediate attack is omitted.

findings.highlight: She’ll get attacked without being able to defend
findings.evidenceJa: 無防備の背中を襲われてしまう
findings.governingReading: her defenseless back will be attacked
findings.explanation: The precise exposure created by Saber tending Shirou becomes generic inability to defend.

findings.highlight: Nobody can pick a flower that only appears for an instant.
findings.evidenceJa: 刹那の花を摘むことなど誰にも出来ぬ
findings.governingReading: No one could bring himself to pluck a flower blooming for one fleeting instant
findings.explanation: Assassin’s aesthetic metaphor loses the flower’s transient bloom and the social sense of refusing so graceless an act.

findings.highlight: I was charmed by your face. Your fighting face was nice, but your tense face is beautiful as well.
findings.evidenceJa: その横顔に見とれただけよ。果たし合う顔も良かったが、今の張り詰めようも捨てがたくてな
findings.governingReading: I was merely captivated by your profile; your face in combat was fine, but your present taut bearing is hard to resist as well
findings.explanation: Assassin’s observation of Saber’s profile and entire strained bearing becomes a pair of generic facial appraisals.

findings.highlight: The traditionally-dressed Servant
findings.evidenceJa: とんでもなく時代錯誤な格好
findings.governingReading: the Servant in an outrageously anachronistic outfit
findings.explanation: Shirou’s comic judgment of Assassin’s dress as wildly out of time disappears.

findings.highlight: turns his back
findings.evidenceJa: そう言い流して、あっさり俺たちに背を向けた
findings.governingReading: tosses the remark off and casually turns his back on us
findings.explanation: Assassin’s effortless dismissal and composure are omitted.

findings.highlight: That is not my wish.
findings.evidenceJa: 私とてそれは惜しい
findings.governingReading: I too would find that regrettable
findings.explanation: Assassin’s regret at an unsatisfying duel becomes an unexplained personal wish.

findings.highlight: The sword attacks with lightning speed.
findings.evidenceJa: 閃光のような迎撃
findings.governingReading: an interception like a flash of light
findings.explanation: The intervening counterattack is made an autonomous sword attack and “flash” becomes speed.

findings.highlight: Assassin readies his sword
findings.evidenceJa: 切っ先を僅かに上げた
findings.governingReading: Assassin raises the point of his blade slightly
findings.explanation: A minimal, composed adjustment becomes a full combat-ready action.

findings.highlight: is going for the enemy’s neck
findings.evidenceJa: 相手の首だけを狙っている
findings.governingReading: is aimed solely at his opponent’s neck
findings.explanation: The exclusive precision distinguishing Assassin’s killing intent from broad pressure is weakened.

findings.highlight: They attack each other with amazing techniques.
findings.evidenceJa: 目を見張るほどの剣戟
findings.governingReading: a dazzling exchange of sword blows unfolds between them
findings.explanation: The sudden visual sword exchange becomes a generic summary of technique.

findings.highlight: Even to my experienced eyes
findings.evidenceJa: 多少は心得がある程度の俺の目
findings.governingReading: to my eyes, which have only some modest familiarity with swordsmanship
findings.explanation: Shirou’s limited experience is inflated into expertise.

findings.highlight: Assassin’s incomprehensible attacks
findings.evidenceJa: アサシンの太刀筋
findings.governingReading: Assassin’s incomprehensible sword paths
findings.explanation: The object of Shirou’s perception is generalized from precise sword trajectories to attacks.

findings.highlight: techniques only trained by his will
findings.evidenceJa: 鉄の意思で鍛え上げられた技量
findings.governingReading: skill forged by an iron will
findings.explanation: The defining hardness of the will behind Archer’s acquired skill disappears.

findings.highlight: after treating my wound and getting changed
findings.evidenceJa: 藤ねえを起こさないように着替えも済ませて
findings.governingReading: after treatment and changing clothes without waking Fuji-nee
findings.explanation: The household precaution and Taiga’s sleeping presence disappear.

findings.highlight: my immature actions for complaining
findings.evidenceJa: グチを言うなんて子供っぽかった
findings.governingReading: that complaining like this was childish
findings.explanation: A specific self-rebuke over grumbling becomes vague reflection on plural actions.

findings.highlight: She says so in utter amazement.
findings.evidenceJa: 心なしかセイバーの口調には親しみが籠もっていたような
findings.governingReading: If anything, Saber’s tone seemed to contain a trace of affection
findings.explanation: The English invents “utter amazement” before Shirou’s tentative perception of warmth.

findings.highlight: Archer is not cruel
findings.evidenceJa: アーチャーは非道ではない
findings.governingReading: Archer is probably not inhuman or morally depraved
findings.explanation: Saber’s broad moral assessment is narrowed to cruelty.

findings.highlight: I was crazy back then
findings.evidenceJa: さっきのは気の迷いだ
findings.governingReading: That earlier feeling was only a passing lapse
findings.explanation: Shirou’s comic denial of admiration becomes a claim of insanity.

findings.highlight: you have talent as well
findings.evidenceJa: シロウも筋がいい
findings.governingReading: you too show good aptitude
findings.explanation: Saber’s assessment of trainable aptitude becomes innate talent, undercutting the scene’s acquired-skill contrast.

findings.highlight: be able to be as good as Archer
findings.evidenceJa: アーチャーに届く技量になりましょう
findings.governingReading: your skill may come within reach of Archer’s
findings.explanation: A prospective ability to approach Archer’s level is strengthened into equality.

findings.highlight: You said I have talent
findings.evidenceJa: 俺、筋がいいって言ったな
findings.governingReading: You said I showed good aptitude
findings.explanation: Shirou repeats Saber’s aptitude judgment, but the English again converts it into talent.

findings.highlight: Teach me stuff
findings.evidenceJa: 剣を教えてくれ
findings.governingReading: teach me swordsmanship
findings.explanation: Shirou’s precise request at a major training transition becomes conspicuously vague.

findings.highlight: I hold Saber’s hand
findings.evidenceJa: ぐっ、とセイバーの手を握って
findings.governingReading: I firmly clasp Saber’s hand
findings.explanation: The force and resolve in Shirou’s physical appeal disappear.
